title: Volunteer Opportunities - Northwest Healthcare Tucson
hours_note: At least four hours per week and commit to a minimum of six months (about 100 hours)
schedule_flexibility: Flexible scheduling with various roles available
description: Hospital volunteer opportunities at Northwest Healthcare in Tucson, supporting patients, families, and staff in clinical and non-clinical roles
requirements: Minimum age 18, six-month commitment (~100 hours), background check, immunization requirements

title: Volunteer Program - Onvida Health (Tucson)
hours_note: Service commitment of at least four hours per week and six months or more
description: Volunteer with Onvida Health in Tucson, providing support to patients, visitors, and care teams in a hospital setting
requirements: Online application, minimum age 18, background check, no prior experience required, on-the-job training provided
contact: Apply online at onvidahealth.org/volunteer or call 520-XXX-XXXX

title: Neighbor Support / Computer Check-in Volunteer
organization: Community Food Bank of Southern Arizona
location: Tucson, AZ (3003 S Country Club Rd)
hours_note: Typical commitment 2.5-3.5 hours per shift; can do once per week (2.5-3.5 hrs) or multiple shifts; commit at least once per week for 3 months
description: Help neighbors with computer system check-ins and provide friendly, supportive contact to community members. Bilingual (English/Spanish) strongly preferred.
requirements: Background check, ability to work independently, computer literacy, strong communication skills, bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred

title: Hospice Volunteer - Emblem Hospice Tucson
hours_note: A few hours per week. Minimum 1 hour per week commitment.
schedule_flexibility: Flexible, with weekday and weekend options
description: Volunteer providing companionship and support to terminally ill patients and their families in Tucson. Ideal for those with empathy and a desire to make a meaningful impact in end-of-life care.
requirements: Background check, orientation training, reliable transportation (if visiting patients), compassionate demeanor
contact: Apply via Idealist listing or contact Emblem Hospice Tucson directly

title: Volunteer Crisis Counselor
location: Remote (anywhere with computer and secure internet)
hours_note: Commit to 4 hours per week until 200 hours are reached (ideally within one year)
schedule_flexibility: 100% remote, schedule your own shifts, 24/7 availability
description: Answer text messages from people in crisis via Crisis Text Line's secure online platform. Work remotely from home with trained supervision.
requirements: 18+, private computer with secure reliable internet, 15-30 hour free online training, background check, commitment to 200 total hours

title: Virtual Service Pilot Participant
hours_note: Projects last 3-6 months and require 5-15 hours each week
schedule_flexibility: Flexible, collaborate online with host country partners
description: Donate 5-15 hours weekly online with global partners across six sectors in over 50 countries for 3-6 month projects
requirements: Computer and internet access, flexible schedule, willingness to collaborate with international partners

title: Online Volunteer Tutor
hours_note: 60-minute lessons 1-2x per week for at least 4 months
schedule_flexibility: Create your own schedule with students
description: One-on-one online tutoring for students, helping with homework, academic skills, and confidence-building
requirements: Application process; commit to 1-2 sessions per week for 4 months

title: Virtual Volunteer Tutor
hours_note: 2 hours a week, twice a week (45 minute sessions) for 12 weeks minimum
description: Tutor under-resourced students online; 45-minute sessions twice a week for 12 weeks
requirements: No prior experience required; training provided

title: Online Volunteer Tutor
hours_note: Commit a little over an hour per week
description: Online tutoring for K-12 students to improve reading skills and confidence

title: Volunteer Data Entry
hours_note: Minimum 5 hours per week (but can volunteer more) with flexible hours and a minimum of a 6-month commitment
description: Remote volunteer data entry for nonprofits
requirements: Experience working with data entry systems, computer skills

title: UN Volunteer
hours_note: Projects last 3-6 months and require 5-15 hours each week
description: Volunteer with UN Volunteers to support global development goals through 5-15 hours weekly online work
requirements: Computer and internet access, 5-15 hours weekly commitment

title: Virtual Mentor
hours_note: Weekly Zoom calls with older adults; flexible scheduling
description: Join DOROT's virtual mentoring program to engage with older adults through weekly Zoom calls
requirements: Must be 16 or older, comfortable with video calls
contact: Sign up via Rosterfy platform or DOROT website
